verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs claim H200 performance comes 'within the same power profile as the H100'. Paired with the vendor's 1.9X Llama2 70B inference claim, this implies better performance per watt, but no wattage or TDP figure is given and no testing is cited. The NVL note about lower-power, air-cooled racks covers a different SKU, and the community items are about memory, not power. missing for 10: an explicit SXM power envelope (TDP/configurable range), sustained-load power behavior, and independent or hands-on performance-per-watt testing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing

citations.quote: This cutting-edge technology offers unparalleled performance, all within the same power profile as the H100.
